description: This file defines a PHP class 'ClaimController' in the namespace OrangeHRM\Claim\Controller. It extends an abstract controller and sets up a Vue component called 'claim-event' during the preRender phase. The file acts as a controller component in an MVC architecture for handling claims in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ClaimController
classes.description: Controller handling claim-related logic, extends AbstractVueController, and sets up Vue component for the claim interface.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the Vue component for the claim feature before rendering the view.
